title: Finance & Legal TODOs - personal scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad - finance/legal personal TODOs (notes to self)

INVOICE CHECKS
- Vendor: LambdaCloud - INV-2026-011 (due 2026-03-05) - amount $18,450. Status: pending approval. Need PO number from procurement (asked via Slack w/ @Samir 2026-02-25). TODO: escalate if no PO by 2026-03-03.
- Vendor: Acme Transcriptions - INV-99 (recurring monthly) - $420 - auto-pay on file? Check card ending 2243. If expired, update by 2026-03-10.
- Vendor: BrightMetrics - annual invoice 2026-04-15 - $12,000 - budget commit claimed by Analytics. Confirm headcount allocation for spread. Linked JIRA: FIN-1234 (budget reconciliation).
- Quick checks: map invoice -> PO -> GL code. Flag any with missing vendor tax ID.

CONTRACT REDLINES / REVIEWS
- Sales contract: Acme Corp SOW v2 (GH:repo/contract-redlines#45) - redline for IP assignment + indemnity. Priority: high (client wants sign by 2026-03-20). Draft comments in GH PR. Action: add clause limiting liability to 1x fees and push back on client-supplied SLA.
- MSA template updates - add KYC requirement for EU customers (legal asked 2026-02-10). TODO: work with @Ava to get wording.
- Security addendum for Private deployments - follow up with infra team on encryption-at-rest wording. Open question: include customer-managed KMS + HSM options in SA? (note: we add optional clause).

RENEWALS / SUBSCRIPTIONS (calendar)
- CloudInfra (GCP committed) - renewal 2026-06-01 - negotiate scale discount if renewal by 2026-05-01. Owner: Procurement (Samir).
- SSO provider (AuthZero) - auto-renews 2026-04-02 - check seat count; possibly drop 10 seats. Owner: IT.
- Monitoring (BrightMetrics above) - annual renewal 2026-04-15 - budgeting hold.
- Domain registrar - auto-renew check (owner: Legal ops). Confirm no stray domains.

MEETING PREP / NOTES
- 2026-03-03 sync with Legal (Ava) - topics: MSA updates, Acme SOW, BrightMetrics renewal. Prep: bring list of priority clauses, expected negotiation points, fallback positions.
- Quick bullets for CFO: summary of upcoming cash outflows (Mar-Apr): LambdaCloud $18k, BrightMetrics $12k, recurring $5k/month.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS
- Who owns proof-of-delivery docs for LambdaCloud? (procurement or vendor ops?) - ACTION: ask procurement 2026-02-27.
- Confirm vendor tax IDs for any invoice > $5k. Build small spreadsheet if necessary.
- Contract redline workflow: standardize how engineers comment on legal PRs (GH vs Confluence).

SHORT TERM TASKS (next 7 days)
- [ ] Add PO number to LambdaCloud invoice (due 2026-03-03)
- [ ] Update Acme SOW redlines and push GH PR (due 2026-03-06)
- [ ] Confirm BrightMetrics renewal owner + budget line (due 2026-03-10)
- [ ] Verify payment method for Acme Transcriptions (card exp check)

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep redlines concise: focus on operational risk (IP, liability, data handling). Avoid re-negotiating commercial terms unless material.
- Save examples of accepted clauses to Confluence page (CONFLUENCE:FIN-ops-invoices).
- If client pushes hard on indemnity, escalate to Legal lead (Ava) + get sign-off from CEO for exceptions.

RANDOM / SCRATCH IDEAS
- Could create a small template for "renewal owner + negotiation playbook" - one-pager. Might help scale as team grows.
- Build a recurring calendar reminder (Finance) 60/30/14/7 days before large renewals.

End of scratchpad - will clean up and move actionable items to FIN-1234/LEGAL-987 after this sync.

-- rita
